title: A probabilistic construction of maximum $h$-scattered subspaces
summary: Let $1\le h\le n-2$ and $g=\gcd(n,h+1)$. We prove that, for every prime power $q$, a maximum $h$-scattered $\mathbb{F}_q$-subspace of $V(r,q^n)$ exists whenever $(h+1)\mid rn$ and $$r\ge\frac{h+1}{g}\bigl(h(n-h-2)+1\bigr).$$ In particular, for fixed $n$ and minimum distance $δ\in\{2,\ldots,n-1\}$, $\mathbb{F}_{q^n}$-linear MRD codes of length $N$ exist for every $q$ and every sufficiently large $N$ such that $n$ divides $(n-δ+1)N$, with a bound on $N$ depending only on $n$ and $δ$.
